definitions.explanation: A felt-tip marker with fluorescent ink used to mark text for emphasis.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}なところに{蛍光|けいこう}ペンで{線|せん}を{引|ひ}いた。
examples.english: I highlighted the important parts with a highlighter.

examples.japanese: {蛍光|けいこう}ペンを{忘|わす}れたので{貸|か}してください。
examples.english: I forgot my highlighter, so please lend me one.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}{違|ちが}いの{蛍光|けいこう}ペンを{使|つか}い{分|わ}けている。
examples.english: I use different colored highlighters for different purposes.

notes:
{蛍光|けいこう}ペン is the standard term for a highlighter pen in Japanese. The name literally means "fluorescent pen."

FORMS:
{蛍光|けいこう} (fluorescence) + ペン (pen). {蛍光|けいこう} uses the kanji for firefly ({蛍|ほたる}) and light ({光|ひかり}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛍光|けいこう}ペンで{線|せん}を{引|ひ}く (to highlight with a highlighter)
- {蛍光|けいこう}ペンでマークする (to mark with a highlighter)
- {蛍光|けいこう}ペンを{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける (to use different highlighters for different purposes)

ALTERNATE TERMS:
- マーカー / マーカーペン (marker pen — also common)
- ハイライター (highlighter — loanword, less common in Japan)
